# libnds

- **Project:** libnds, the open-source Nintendo DS library maintained by devkitPro.
- **Authors:** Michael Noland (joat), Jason Rogers (dovoto), Dave Murphy (WinterMute), fincs and the other contributors named in its sources (`libnds_license.txt`).
- **URL:** https://github.com/devkitPro/libnds
- **Version we read:** commit `84e6082` (2026-02-17).
- **License:** zlib license (`libnds_license.txt` in that repo).

## What we take

Names only: 33 hardware and library identifiers that libnds also uses, kept as they are in our headers and C so the code reads like other DS projects. We checked each one against our ROM. No code, comments or files come from libnds.
